reason: A plugin analysis and auditing tool that reviews candidate and installed DeepSeek Harness plugins using source heuristics and an LLM, then reports model-dependent risks and re-audit reminders.

summaries.zh: 用于在安装前后分析 DeepSeek Harness 插件源码、评估其能力与约束风险，并在模型切换后提醒重新审核。
summaries.en: Analyzes DeepSeek Harness plugin source before and after installation, assesses capability and constraint risks, and reminds users to re-audit after model changes.

capabilities: Scans installed plugin source files locally
Fetches candidate plugin source from npm, jsDelivr, or GitHub raw URLs
Uses an LLM to assess plugin value and model-specific constraint risk
Persists audit history and model fingerprints locally
Monitors model changes and presents re-audit reminders
